sloka: मही कृता पर्वत राजि पूर्णा ।शैलाः कृता वृक्ष वितान पूर्णाः ।वृक्षाः क्Rताः पुष्प वितान पूर्णाः ।पुष्पम् क्Rतम् केसर पत्र पूर्णम् ॥५-७-९॥
transliteration: mahī kṛtā parvata rāji pūrṇā ।śailāḥ kṛtā vṛkṣa vitāna pūrṇāḥ ।vṛkṣāḥ kRtāḥ puṣpa vitāna pūrṇāḥ ।puṣpam kRtam kesara patra pūrṇam ॥5-7-9॥

translations.english: The whole earth had been picturised on it. It was filled with rows of mountains and a canopy of trees all over. The trees were filled with lovely flowers with petals and filaments drawn on them.
